description: Not decided. Bird bath: a store item placed like a feeder (`FeederPlacer` is the pattern), sipped and bathed at like the pool, perches on the rim; takes thirsty traffic off the pool (questions: shelf and price, how many, does it need filling). Comfort items on each species' shelf (dust bath, thistle sock, sunning stone) that change how long birds stay and how often they return; other garden pieces bought with feathers (a log, a berry bush) that change which birds come. Mulch (what rotted seed becomes). Weather tie-ins: rain helps sprouts, wind carries seed, snow buries ground seed, more bathers after rain stops.
title: Step 13c: Bird bath and comfort items
